title: Value-Informed Schedule Trimming for Accelerated Sequential Monte Carlo Guidance in Discrete Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.20669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward-guided discrete diffusion enables test-time alignment with downstream objectives, but applying Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) guidance at every denoising step is computationally expensive. Active guidance steps require additional reward evaluations and, for gradient-based proposals, value-gradient computations. Sparse guidance reduces this cost by guiding only a subset of timesteps, but commonly used schedules are fixed heuristics whose effectiveness can vary substantially across tasks. We propose VISTA, a training-free method that automatically selects guided timesteps under a fixed budget. VISTA formulates sparse guidance as approximation of the ideal full-guidance probability path and derives an estimable upper bound on \(\ell_1\) path deviation. translated_title: 用于加速离散扩散中序贯蒙特卡洛引导的价值信息驱动的调度裁剪方法
translated_abstract: 奖励引导的离散扩散能够在测试时与下游目标实现对齐，但在每个去噪步骤都应用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）引导的计算代价十分高昂。主动引导步骤需要额外的奖励评估，而对于基于梯度的提议方法，还需要进行价值梯度计算。稀疏引导通过仅对部分时间步施加引导来降低这一成本，但常用的调度方案是固定的启发式规则，其有效性在不同任务之间可能存在显著差异。我们提出VISTA，这是一种无需训练的方法，可在固定预算下自动选择需要引导的时间步。VISTA将稀疏引导表述为对理想完全引导概率路径的近似，并推导出ℓ₁路径偏差的一个可估计上界。利用从少量完全引导预热生成中收集的价值统计量，VISTA通过动态规划对该经验代理目标进行精确优化。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: VISTA是一种无需训练的方法，通过将稀疏引导建模为对理想完全引导概率路径的近似，并利用预热阶段收集的价值统计量结合动态规划精确求解经验代理目标，从而在固定计算预算下自动选择最优的引导时间步，显著加速离散扩散模型中的序贯蒙特卡洛奖励引导。
en_tdlr: VISTA is a training-free method that accelerates Sequential Monte Carlo guidance in discrete diffusion by automatically selecting guided timesteps under a fixed budget, formulating sparse guidance as an approximation of the ideal full-guidance probability path and exactly optimizing an empirical value-based surrogate via dynamic programming.
